source_text: Documentation must match actual behavior; a doc that lies is worse than no doc.
pattern: Documentation must match actual behavior; a doc that lies is worse than no doc.
reason: Wrong docs cost more than missing docs.

source_text: A README that answers what/why/how-to-run in 60 seconds is the highest-leverage doc a project has.
pattern: A README that answers what/why/how-to-run in 60 seconds is the highest-leverage doc a project has.
reason: The README is the front door of a project.

source_text: Record significant decisions as ADRs with context and alternatives; they prevent re-litigating settled questions.
pattern: Record significant decisions as ADRs with context and alternatives; they prevent re-litigating settled questions.
reason: ADR context is what the next team can't recover from code.

source_text: Docs live and die by examples: every API endpoint and every CLI flag deserves one copy-pasteable example.
pattern: Docs live and die by examples: every API endpoint and every CLI flag deserves one copy-pasteable example.
reason: Examples are the part readers actually use.

source_text: Document the why, not just the what; code shows what it does, only docs can explain the intent and constraints.
pattern: Document the why, not just the what; code shows what it does, only docs can explain the intent and constraints.
reason: Intent is the one thing code cannot express.
